import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        final int val;

        ModInt() { val = 0; }
        ModInt(long v) {
            int mod = MOD;
            v %= mod;
            if (v < 0) v += mod;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt b) {
            long res = (long) val + b.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt b) {
            long res = (long) val - b.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt b) {
            long res = (long) val * b.val % MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt b) {
            return multiply(b.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            int a = val, mod = MOD;
            int b = mod, ax = 1, bx = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                int q = a / b, t = a % b;
                a = b; b = t;
                t = ax - bx * q;
                ax = bx; bx = t;
            }
            // a should be 1
            if (ax < 0) ax += mod;
            return new ModInt(ax);
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt a = this;
            ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof ModInt)) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }

        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    interface HalfCallback {
        void apply(int sets, ModInt p);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt[] prob = new ModInt[N * N];
        ModInt inv100 = new ModInt(100).inv();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            prob[i] = new ModInt(x).multiply(inv100);
        }

        int mid = N / 2;
        int[] maskToIdx = new int[1 << 6];
        int idxCount = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 6); mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == mid) {
                maskToIdx[mask] = idxCount++;
            } else {
                maskToIdx[mask] = -1;
            }
        }

        int totalSize = 1 << idxCount;
        ModInt[] total = new ModInt[totalSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) total[i] = new ModInt(0);

        // process first half
        processHalf(N, prob, maskToIdx, 0, mid, (sets, p) -> total[sets] = total[sets].add(p));

        // SOS DP (subset sum)
        for (int d = 1; d < totalSize; d <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
                if ((i & d) == 0) {
                    total[i | d] = total[i | d].add(total[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        ModInt[] ans = new ModInt[]{new ModInt(0)};
        processHalf(N, prob, maskToIdx, mid, N, (sets, p) -> {
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(p.multiply(total[totalSize - 1].subtract(total[totalSize - 1 - sets])));
        });

        System.out.println((int) ans[0].val);
    }

    static void processHalf(int N, ModInt[] prob, int[] maskToIdx,
                            int left, int right, HalfCallback callback) {
        int len = right - left;
        int numEdges = 1 << (len * N);
        for (int edge = 0; edge < numEdges; edge++) {
            ModInt p = new ModInt(1);
            int shift = edge;
            for (int pos = left * N; pos < right * N; pos++, shift >>= 1) {
                ModInt term;
                if ((shift & 1) == 1) {
                    term = prob[pos];
                } else {
                    term = new ModInt(1).subtract(prob[pos]);
                }
                p = p.multiply(term);
                if (p.val == 0) {
                    break; // skip this edge (like goto skip)
                }
            }
            if (p.val == 0) continue; // skip if p became zero

            int sets = 0;
            int[] data = new int[len]; // initially zeros
            while (true) {
                int mm = 0;
                boolean ok = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                    int pos = i * N + data[i];
                    if (((edge >> pos) & 1) == 0) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    if ((mm & (1 << data[i])) != 0) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    mm |= (1 << data[i]);
                }
                if (ok) {
                    if (right == N) {
                        mm ^= (1 << N) - 1;
                    }
                    int idx = maskToIdx[mm];
                    if (idx != -1) {
                        sets |= (1 << idx);
                    }
                }

                // increment data (base N counter)
                int i = len - 1;
                for (; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (data[i] < N - 1) {
                        data[i]++;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        data[i] = 0;
                    }
                }
                if (i < 0) break;
            }
            callback.apply(sets, p);
        }
    }
}
